d2.criterion_text: D2 Sufficiency score ≥ 4 (blocking). Capability-complete: required + defaults complete write capability or fail closed; every mandatory stored attribute has a defined fill source; Response carries status/writes/errors and optional log row.

d3.criterion_text: D3 Non-overlap score ≥ 4 (blocking). One job per field; aliases document winner + deprecation; multi-source attributes have stated precedence; default Response is not an audit echo stack.
